summary: Practise MongoDB documents, CRUD, aggregation, schema design, and indexes. Review the five-day fundamentals course outline.
lede: MongoDB fundamentals training helps developers, database support staff, and analysts handle document collections and routine queries. Learners practise creating and updating documents, shaping schemas and aggregation results, and reviewing indexes and query plans with MongoDB Shell and Compass, building a foundation for development and support tasks rather than production architecture design.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who work with MongoDB data or support applications that store it. It suits foundation-level learners who need to perform routine document-database tasks and communicate clearly with development or database teams.
prerequisites: Foundation level. No prior MongoDB administration experience is expected. Basic computer use and familiarity with structured data are helpful. General programming is not required; exercises use MongoDB commands and query syntax.
